name: Priya Patel
discretionary_target: Provide specific delivery estimate context relative to her deadline

turns.text: Hi, I'm worried about my order ORD-3001. I need it by the 15th — it's for an event and I can't be without it.
Yes, that's me. My customer ID is CUST-003.
It's Priya Patel, P-R-I-Y-A, last name P-A-T-E-L. My phone number on file is the best way to reach me.

Okay, so it's in-transit... but when exactly should I expect it? Like, is it going to arrive before the 15th or are we cutting it really close? I need to know if I can actually count on this or if I should start looking for a backup plan.
Also, just so you know ? I'm actually moving next month. Will the delivery go to my current address? I don't want it showing up after I've left.
And there's no way to expedite it or check the carrier tracking to get a more specific date? I'm just nervous because the event is non-negotiable.
Alright, I appreciate you looking into that. At least I know where things stand now. I'll keep an eye on my email for updates and hope the tracking info comes through soon. Thank you.
